name: Mosaic
tagline: Mosaic is a strategic finance platform that connects to ERPs, CRMs, and data warehouses to provide real-time financial dashboards, rolling forecasts, and scenario modelling. Its AI features include natural language metric querying and automated variance analysis that explains why numbers changed.
